name: Dental House Clinic : คลินิกทันตกรรมเด็นทัลเฮ้าส์

summary_en: Dental House Clinic is a dental facility located in Bangkok. It holds a 4.9-star rating based on 4 total reviews and maintains a trust score of 56.2.
